name: Custom Zango app
one_liner: Any business app on plain Zango: describe its roles, data, workflows and pages in one spec and watch a clickable preview of it take shape before anything is built.
fits_when: no domain template fits the requirement
the app is mostly records, forms, lists and approval workflows
different roles see different menus, records and actions
a record moves through statuses with role-gated transitions
a central record needs a 360 page with related lists and a timeline
gives_you: Roles with their own menus and landing pages
List pages with search, filters, quick views and row actions
Create and edit forms with validation and duplicate checks
Status workflows with role-gated transitions, tags and confirmations
Row-level access per role, including external logins that see only their own records
360 pages with header facts, stats, related tabs and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A generic Zango app described in the Zango app spec (v1): roles and menus, modules and entities with fields, access, workflows, forms and list tables, and 360 detail pages. The spec is previewed live as a clickable app with demo data while the requirement is shaped.

compliance: Audit trail of every change and transition

changelog: Example: detail routes quoted so every YAML parser reads them. Preview: the sketch kit draws data-zas-kit markers, the same ones as the build's design system, so the build can check a custom screen against its sketch. Interview: the analyst no longer asks whether to finish or build; the user commits from the preview. Preview: a user field named after a role (assigned_verifier) holds that role's demo users; the agent is told when a custom screen reads a field the demo data never fills. Spec: `type: dashboard` pages declared block by block (KPIs, charts, lists, tables, boards), `app.ui` (radius, density), contracts on custom work (data, interactions, acceptance) and typed custom requirements (trigger, acceptance). Preview: Point at any part of the app to tell the agent what you mean (every drawn part carries its spec path); the preview reports where you are and opens at a given place. Custom pages, 360 tabs and panels can be checked headlessly (ZAS_PROBE): the analyst runs each sketch per role, reads what it drew and screenshots it. Build: the zango-app-studio build skill now ships with Agent Mode's skill plugin instead of inside this pack.
